home.title: The Istaravshan school portal
home.lead: The class register, the timetable, marks and attendance — in one place. For the teacher, for the pupil, for the parents.

journal.title: The same register
journal.body: The page opens exactly as a Tajik class register looks: dates written upwards across the top, surnames down the left, and in each square either a mark or a letter for an absence. A teacher has nothing to relearn.

parents.title: Parents know the same day
parents.body: A mark a teacher enters is in the parents' Telegram twelve minutes later, and the day's summary arrives in the evening — not at the end of the term, when nothing can be put right.

official.title: Everyone sees their own
official.body: What a person may see is decided by the database, not by the look of a page. The teacher sees their class register, the pupil their marks, the parents only their own child.

journal.title: The class register and marks
journal.body: A mark or an absence in one square, the term column at the end, the topic of each lesson on the facing page. Every mark keeps its date, its subject and the name of the teacher who entered it.

timetable.title: Timetable and attendance
timetable.body: The weekly timetable of classes and teachers, bells, rooms and substitutions. Two lessons at the same hour simply will not save.

parents.title: The parents' Telegram bot
parents.body: Parents sign in with their child's nickname and the code the school printed. Marks, absences, timetable and the day's summary — with no account and no portal password.

people.title: Starting from one file
people.body: Pupils, staff and the timetable are read from an Excel file. The portal issues everyone a login and a password and hands the same file back with them filled in.

content.title: The life of the school
content.body: Announcements, news, events, official documents and an electronic library — with photographs, comments and pupils mentioned by name.

languages.title: Three languages, in full
languages.body: Tajik, Russian and English — every page, every message and every document. Each person chooses their own.

home.aboutTitle: About the system and about us
home.aboutBody: This portal was built for the schools of Istaravshan. It has one aim: to gather what is scattered today across paper registers and WhatsApp groups into one orderly, dependable place — without making a teacher do the same work twice.
home.startBody: The school administration issues the login and password. Enter them on the sign-in page.

download.title: Get the app
download.subtitle: and use the portal more easily: notifications, quick launch, everything one tap away.

app.title: The МТМУ №7 app
app.lead: The same portal on your phone and computer: notifications for new messages, quick launch, and one tap to lessons and marks.

android.step2: If the phone asks, allow the browser to install unknown apps.
android.step3: Tap Install and open the app from your home screen.

ios.step1: Open the portal in Safari (on iPhone only Safari can install it).
ios.step2: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) and choose Add to Home Screen.
ios.step3: Tap Add: the МТМУ №7 icon appears on your Home Screen.

windows.step2: If Windows warns you, click More info → Run anyway.
windows.step3: The app appears on your desktop and in the Start menu.

app.note: The app uses the same account: sign in with the same login and password.
